_doc: CHAIN AND CHARGE (G2, docs/GUNS.md 6): chain {steps, cut, decay_s}: each volley within the cooldown plus 1.5 s of the last adds a step (up to steps) and each step cuts the cooldown by cut, one after the other; steps fall away one a second after decay_s idle. charge {max, gap_s}: the gun stores a volley each cooldown while it is ready, up to max; a fire order fires the volley in the barrel and releases the stored ones gap_s apart; the AI and the autofire only give the order at max or when the target shield is down. version: the one-line card text naming the version; family: laser, pulse, ion, flak, missile, beam, slug or pd (the bench reads it). Read-only state for the UI (weapons.gd): chain_steps(arena, ship_idx, uid), chain_max(def), charges(arena, ship_idx, uid), charge_max(def). Combat stats of weapons, keyed by component id (read by scripts/combat/weapons.gd; the arena also fires the test_* ids without a placed component). kind: laser (hitscan), bolt (projectile), flak (several spread projectiles), missile (slow, homing, splash, passes shields) or beam (a hitscan line held for duration; damage is per second). damage_type: kinetic, energy, explosive or ion. cooldown and duration in seconds, range in pixels, arc in degrees (turrets only), speed in px/s, turn in rad/s, spread in degrees, splash in cells. pierce: how many more solid cells leftover damage may punch through. fire_chance: chance per shot to start a fire at the first cell hit. Kinds have defaults for the keys left out (see weapons.gd). Optional keys: ammo (a material or item id in cargo, one is spent per shot), jam_chance (chance per volley that the weapon seizes up), heat_per_shot (heat added to the part for each shot), breach_chance (chance per hit that a wall cell is breached outright), effects: a list of tags (lock_doors, drain_power, tether) or an object of weapon effects built in scripts/combat/effects.gd, which lists every key (acid, spores, shard, sonic, magnetic, frost, corrode, split_on_shield on the target; self_room, needs_operator, needs_crew_in_room, ammo_mult on the shooter; intercept, for turrets: point defence against missiles); tests/test_fx_effects.gd and test_components.gd validate them. The art looks for art/projectiles/<weapon id> (and <weapon id>_impact) before the kind's. Aiming (docs/CONTENT.md 4 and 4f): a weapon sits in a hull mount and points outward through its wall. turret false is a FIXED gun: it fires along the mount's outward direction, turned up to gimbal degrees toward the cursor, so the ship is aimed. turret true rotates itself within arc degrees (centred on the outward direction) at track degrees per second, aims at the enemy with perfect lead and fires when ready; each shot rolls accuracy minus the target's evasion for a hit (docs/CONTENT.md 4). damage is the FIXED equivalent at the weapon's tier: the aim class share of it is what a tracking weapon really deals. AIM CLASSES (docs/GUNS.md 2): aim is fixed, swivel or turret. fixed: the ship is aimed, gimbal degrees (up to 8, 20 for a broadside or gun strip). swivel and turret track by themselves (turret true) within arc degrees at track degrees per second: a swivel 120 to 180 degrees, a turret 270 to 360. The share of the entry's damage a weapon really deals is aim_share[class] (fixed 1.0, swivel 0.8, turret 0.6; the old turret_damage key still sets the turret share when aim_share is missing); a weapon with no aim key is a turret when turret is true, else fixed. shapes: the gun shapes (the shape key of a component names one): outside is the half in space (w x h at rotation 0, h is how far it sticks out), breech the usual inside half, aim its class; tests/test_gun_shapes.gd holds every gun to its shape and class bands. POINT DEFENCE: a turret with the intercept effect shoots down the nearest enemy missile, any shot flying at or below pd_speed px/s, or one marked interceptable true, and a ship only when none of those is in range; its own accuracy and cooldown are its tier. The test_* weapons have gimbal 180: they fire anywhere. rapid true marks the few guns that fire a shot or more a second (shots / cooldown >= 1; a flak volley counts as one shot): they are turrets with damage 1 and a cooldown of 0.4 to 0.8 s, 10 to 15% of the guns, and every other gun stays under one shot a second (tests/test_weapons.gd checks both). sound (optional): the id of the sound it makes when it fires (data/audio.json); it wins over the kind and line sounds (the ten races' signature guns have one; scripts/audio/audio.gd weapon_sound). MOUNT PLATING (fights-end C, docs/GUNS.md 15): every gun (family weapon: its part and the outside half of its mount) takes mount_plating of the damage of a hit, so a gun lasts 1 / mount_plating times as long under fire (0.4: 2.5x; they were knocked out in 10-20 s); its hp, the repair job and the saved damage are as before.

shields._doc: Shield HP and timing (scripts/combat/shields.gd, scripts/sim/abilities.gd). recharge: seconds a used layer takes to come back at normal speed; a part's stats.recharge is its own seconds a layer. The used layers of a sector come back one at a time (the next timer starts when the one before it is back). break_delay: seconds more a sector waits for its first layer once its last whole layer is used. tier_recharge and neon_mult: the stats.recharge a pack's shield follows by tier (x neon_mult on the neon line); tests/test_content.gd checks it. SHIELD HP (v2): a sector holds layers x weight x layer_hp shield HP; a hit takes its damage off the pool and what is left passes to the hull (an ion hit takes 2x its damage and locks the bubble). tiers[tier] is the row of a shield part of that tier (the part's own stats.layer_hp / regen_delay / regen_rate / break_delay win): layer_hp, regen_delay (seconds after a hit before regen starts), regen_rate (HP a second, times the part's recharge speed shield_base / stats.recharge and the crew), break_delay (seconds a sector knocked to 0 waits instead). recharge and break_delay above are the old per-layer numbers: recharge is still the base speed of stats.recharge, break_delay is read by the part cards only.
